_doc: Ratios for osm2carin.estimate; see estimate.py and carin-disc-findings.md "Phase 1". Source: original disc CD-ID 5944 (disc-survey) and our OSM model of us/nevada.

street_parcel._fit: least squares over 1,212 CF=1 type 0x00 parcels (every 20th), extent bytes incl. padding, rel. err 13%

_bytes_per_link: street parcel (21.5 + 1348/125) + per-link share of blocks 0x01,0x02,0x03,0x04,0x08,0x09,0x0E,0x0F (60.3 B)
_bytes_per_poi: blocks 0x06+0x10+0x11 / 160,240 distinct phone numbers in 0x10 (lower bound of the POI count)
_fixed_bytes: all other blocks (superblock, country/city tables, letter index, background layers, TMC), kept as on the original
